name: math-tactical-classroom-v60-factorization-mastery-boss
author: Juan Diego Pérez
description: Offline Math Tactical classroom Windows installer with a 45-minute mission, 90-second factorization questions, PIN-protected teacher access, fast normal enemies, and a high-mastery three-phase Archive Warden boss with visible predictive aim, variable committed dash cadence, narrow intentional dodge timing, multi-hit shield and core armor, punish windows, and bounded assist only after 30 boss deaths.

scripts.prepare: node scripts/prepare-classroom-v60.js && node scripts/patch-v60-factorization-workshop.js && node scripts/unpack-v61-boss-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-boss-v61.js && node scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604-runner.js scripts/patch-v60-teacher-mode-v604.js && node scripts/run-v605-relentless-patch.js && node scripts/unpack-v606-fair-dodge-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-fair-dodge-boss-v606.js && node scripts/unpack-v607-mastery-patch.js && node scripts/patch-v60-mastery-boss-v607.js && npm run prepare:icons
scripts.test: npm run prepare && node --check school-game/v60/main.js && node --check school-game/v60/preload.js && node --check school-game/v60/game.js && node scripts/math-factorization-v607-mastery-static-test.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dir:win: npm run prepare && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never

build.productName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.7 Mastery Boss Edition

nsis.shortcutName: Math Tactical Classroom V60.7 Mastery Boss Edition
